<article title="Product care">
Wash technical shells and down jackets on a gentle cycle with a technical-fabric wash, never regular detergent, and tumble dry on low. Down jackets need two or three clean tennis balls in the dryer to restore loft.

Waterproof coatings wear down with use. If water stops beading on a shell, wash it and apply a spray-on re-proofing treatment; this restores the coating without affecting the warranty.

Store sleeping bags and down items uncompressed in a dry place. Long-term compression permanently reduces insulation.

</article>

Customer first name: Rasmus
<request>
coating: care or warranty?
the care page says coatings wear down and i should re-proof. the warranty page says coatings are covered. mine failed after one season. which is it?
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Rasmus,

Thanks for reaching out. Our care guidance says waterproof coatings wear down with use, and that if water stops beading on a shell, you can wash it and apply a spray-on re-proofing treatment, which restores the coating without affecting the warranty.

The article I have doesn't cover the warranty terms for coatings, so I can't confirm from it whether a coating failure after one season is covered. A specialist will follow up with you on that question.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
